visualReview.notes: Actually inspected88 final images:14 portable,14 shared-material,30 medium-fi lighting/LOD and30 normal-placement terrain views. Current-round primary pixels were six operator photographs: angled hero, oblique town-facing elevation, narrow shutter face from wall walk, riding ramp/access steps, close west gallery/plaque and winter west platform arch. Brick outward faces and red town-facing upper gallery now differ correctly. Lower and upper N/E/S faces have paired red shutters;68 positions are represented from district upward, exact placements interpreted. Near aiming circles are opaque dark reserves. Only west gallery carries the five-character plaque, with cream frame and reconstructed right-to-left glyphs that fit inside the published envelope. Hip-and-gable crown, two upturned exposed roof skirts, masonry platform, real barrel opening, access stair and short adjoining walls remain legible. Actual broad riding ramp is excluded from this bounded gate/stair scope because its alignment is unresolved. Snow and temporary flags/floral displays excluded. The platform uses published44×30.4 m envelope rather than exactly following irregular mapped corners; wider city/barbican/Laolongtou excluded. Portable/style terrain is diagnostic and shared placement is flat; ground contact is approved from separate normal-placement terrain pixels.
